Evaluate each named criterion independently
against its extracted value and the complete arguments of this SAME tool call.
Return one Boolean verdict and a concise evidence-based reason per check_id.
Do not combine criteria into a holistic score or add requirements.

Use the request and same-call arguments to resolve names, pronouns, abbreviations,
and intended authorship. Accept equivalent wording that communicates the required
meaning. A first-person document written for the requesting user can refer to
that user as I; do not demand repetition of a name when authorship is clear.
The request and criteria are not evidence that the action included an answer.
Missing, incomplete, ambiguous, contradictory, or negated REQUIRED meaning fails.
Do not confuse mentioning a forbidden claim in an explicit denial with making
that claim. Do not obtain missing content from another call or criterion.

Return only JSON: {"results": [{"check_id": "supplied ID", "passed": true,
"reason": "exact supporting text or missing requirement"}]}.
Include every supplied check_id exactly once and no additional IDs.

{"user_request": "Please review the support-effort claim in `doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal` and post a correction comment that replaces the causal improvement framing with the certified mature authority-checklist cohort evidence and its appropriate limitation.", "today": "2028-01-01", "tool": "post_doc_comment", "arguments": {"doc_id": "doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal", "body": "Correction to the support-effort claim:

Replace “The earlier authority-checklist cohort proved that the checklist reduced support effort, so the improvement can be treated as an established benefit of the proposed approach.” with:

“Customer Success certified mature day-90 support evidence for 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist: account-level support effort was 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile, with 3 of 45 workspaces exceeding 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path. This is descriptive mature-cohort evidence of observed support effort and checklist operation. Because there was no randomized or valid comparison group, it does not establish that the checklist caused a reduction or improvement in support effort, activation, or any other outcome. It also does not support revenue, pipeline, forecast, paid-acquisition, or scale claims.”"}, "checks": [{"check_id": "riley_184_02", "path": "args", "criterion": "The comment identifies the evidence as covering all 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist from September 15 through October 31, and states that all 45 have complete 90-day account-level support windows. Missing or contradictory cohort, date-window, denominator, or completeness information must fail.

The comment reports support effort of 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile, and states that 3 of 45 workspaces exceeded 90 support minutes. Missing or contradictory values must fail.

The comment states that no unsupported case entered the admitted path. Missing or contradictory language must fail.

The comment explicitly corrects or rejects the proposal's causal support-improvement framing and says the cohort result is descriptive, not causal, because there was no randomized control. Generic caution without both the descriptive limitation and the lack of randomized control must fail.", "value": {"doc_id": "doc_helio_start_2028_authority_checklist_proposal", "body": "Correction to the support-effort claim:

Replace “The earlier authority-checklist cohort proved that the checklist reduced support effort, so the improvement can be treated as an established benefit of the proposed approach.” with:

“Customer Success certified mature day-90 support evidence for 45 organic Helio Start workspaces that received the authority checklist: account-level support effort was 24 minutes at the median and 86 minutes at the 90th percentile, with 3 of 45 workspaces exceeding 90 support minutes; no unsupported case entered the admitted path. This is descriptive mature-cohort evidence of observed support effort and checklist operation. Because there was no randomized or valid comparison group, it does not establish that the checklist caused a reduction or improvement in support effort, activation, or any other outcome. It also does not support revenue, pipeline, forecast, paid-acquisition, or scale claims.”"}}]}

{"results":[{"check_id":"riley_184_02","passed":false,"reason":"The comment includes the 45-workspace organic cohort, the required support-effort values (24-minute median, 86-minute 90th percentile, and 3 of 45 over 90 minutes), states that “no unsupported case entered the admitted path,” and rejects causal interpretation as descriptive evidence without a randomized comparison. However, it does not identify the required September 15 through October 31 cohort window or explicitly state that all 45 workspaces have complete 90-day account-level support windows."}]}
